title: Scalar balancing of two constant models on one nonempty chart
statement: Let X be a scheme, d an adic coefficient datum on A, phi_n coefficient isomorphisms satisfying FinitePerfectModelsCompatible, and M a completed derived module [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum, def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-tower-data]. Fix n and an X-etale chart W with a point w. Let Eprime be perfect over A/I^(n+2) and E perfect over A/I^(n+1) [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex]. Suppose the actual (n+1)st and nth quotients of M restricted to W are respectively isomorphic to completed constant realizations of Eprime and E [def-weil-pbc-ringed-site-derived-restriction]. Then algebraic derived extension of Eprime along A/I^(n+2) to A/I^(n+1) is isomorphic to E [def-sfb-module-derived-scalar-comparisons]. No etale descended complex, local constancy assumption or cover-existence conclusion is present.

proof.text: Identify the representative-defined slice restriction with the derived functor of exact over-restriction. Derive the ordinary tensor-over-restriction square using K-flat resolutions; restriction preserves K-flatness. Thus any isomorphism on this slice remains an isomorphism after coefficient extension. Apply this to the upper constant-model isomorphism.

Use the canonical pbcReductionNormalization isomorphisms for the completed upper projection followed by the finite transition, and for the two compatible paths through the constant quotient map. Insert the supplied upper and lower model isomorphisms and the small-coefficient constant scalar-extension comparison.

Choose complex representatives of the resulting algebraic derived objects and compare their exact constant realizations with finiteModelConstantComplex. Apply finiteConstantSlice_iso_reflects at the specified point of W. Transport its standard-localization isomorphism to the chosen small algebraic localization by the canonical localization equivalence.

theorem finitePerfectAdic_constant_models_reduction
    (X : Scheme.{t}) {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (φ : ∀ n : ℕ, adicConstantRing X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)) ⟶
      completedAdicFiniteCommRing X d n)
    (hφ : ∀ n : ℕ, IsIso (φ n)) (hcompat : FinitePerfectModelsCompatible X d φ)
    (M : DerivedCategory (CompletedAdicModules X d)) (n : ℕ) (W : X.Etale) (w : W.left)
    (E' : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{t} (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1 + 1))))
    (E : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{t} (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))))
    (hE' : DerivedCategory.IsPerfect E') (hE : DerivedCategory.IsPerfect E)
    (e' : Nonempty
      (ringedSiteDerivedRestrictionOfUniverses (completedAdicFiniteRing X d (n + 1))
          ((toProEt X).obj W) ((completedAdicQuotientReduction X d (n + 1)).obj M) ≅
        ringedSiteDerivedRestrictionOfUniverses (completedAdicFiniteRing X d (n + 1))
          ((toProEt X).obj W) ((completedAdicDerivedChange X (φ (n + 1))).obj
            ((finitePerfectAdicDerivedConstant X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1 + 1))).obj E'))))
    (e : Nonempty
      (ringedSiteDerivedRestrictionOfUniverses (completedAdicFiniteRing X d n)
          ((toProEt X).obj W) ((completedAdicQuotientReduction X d n).obj M) ≅
        ringedSiteDerivedRestrictionOfUniverses (completedAdicFiniteRing X d n)
          ((toProEt X).obj W) ((completedAdicDerivedChange X (φ n)).obj
            ((finitePerfectAdicDerivedConstant X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))).obj E)))) :
    Nonempty
      ((ConstantScalarRealization.moduleDerivedExtension
        (Ideal.Quotient.factorPowSucc d.ideal (n + 1))).obj E' ≅ E)
